build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions for automatic differentiation with WFSTs
create_cmake_extension: create a CMakeExtension for building native C++ extensions with setuptools
build_cmake_extensions: build CMake extensions for gtn._graph, gtn._autograd, gtn._utils, gtn._rand, gtn._creations, gtn._functions, and gtn._parallel
test_cmake_version: test that cmake version 3.5.1 or higher is installed before building gtn extensions
summarize_setup_config: summarize the setup configuration for the gtn package including extensions, packages, and build requirements
